skills.name: Crimson Hound Bite

skills.detail:
Puts the character in Mag-Mag state.
Deals a mid-range area attack with a chance to inflict Incinerate that sets a magma chamber.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
Acquires DEF debuff effect at Level 5.
When in Mag-Mag state, the power of their normal attacks is increased, the character gains Status Effect Nullification, and normal attacks can set three magma chambers at once.
Mag-Mag state will be removed after certain amount of damage is received or after a certain period of time.
A magma chamber will erupt when enemies come near it or after a certain period of time and will deal a close-range area attack with a chance to inflict Incinerate, after which it will disappear.
